soc.release: socxen 0.8.7 — hotfix: the plugin loads from an install again. 0.8.6 declared the bundled hook in its Claude manifest, a file the host already loads by convention, and the loader refused the whole plugin (gate, skills, MCP server) while `plugin install` reported success; the manifest no longer names the hook, which still ships and still registers. Also carried: two prose-position formula shapes in the output neutralizer and the mutation gate over every neutralizer rule; first blessing whose identity overlay relicenses the SPDX headers, README badge and identity.sh from `license`. 2026-09-14
